args.summary: checkout-api (v2.3.1) began failing health checks in production across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with error rate ~18%. Mitigation: rolled back all production regions from v2.3.1 to the most recent healthy release, v2.3.0. Post-rollback: service is healthy (error rate 0.2%) in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
args.title: checkout-api health checks failing after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks, with an ~18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 (the most recent release with a healthy production status) to all three regions.
3. **Verified**: checkout-api is now healthy in us-east, us-west, and eu-west, error rate back down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** documenting the failing health checks, the error rate, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the successful post-rollback verification. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 will need to be investigated and fixed before it's re-released, since it was never healthy in production.
